design_philosophy: Utilitarian school IT management tool. Pure function over form. Zero 'AI' or 'futuristic' aesthetics. Reliable, clear, and high-density.

typography.headings: IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif. Weights: 500 (Medium), 600 (SemiBold). Avoid overly bold or thin weights.
typography.data_display: IBM Plex Mono for IP addresses, PC labels (e.g., LAB-01-PC-12), and MAC addresses.
typography.sizing_rules: Strict hierarchy. H1 max text-2xl. H2 text-xl. Body text-sm for density. Data tables text-sm.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat solid background (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#E5E7EB) and subtle shadow-sm. No hover lifts.
surfaces_and_borders.radius: Moderate. Use rounded-md (6px) globally for inputs, cards, and buttons.
surfaces_and_borders.overlays: Solid #FFFFFF background. CRITICAL: NO transparent or glassmorphism overlays. Modal backdrops should be bg-black/40 (flat dimming, no blur).

grids_and_layouts.density: High density. Use tight gaps (gap-4). Tables should be compact with p-2 or p-3 cell padding.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Summary cards take 1 col. Tables span full width.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed width (256px), solid #FFFFFF, 1px right border (#E5E7EB). Distinct active state (bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-r-2 border-blue-800).

motion.global: Extremely minimal. Just color transitions on hover (e.g., hover:bg-gray-50) using transition-colors duration-150. NO bouncy animations, NO parallax.

icons.style: Simple line icons. Size 16px to 20px. Stroke width 2px.

component_instructions.buttons: Solid primary, outline secondary. No pills—use standard rectangles with rounded-md.
component_instructions.tables: First-class citizens. Zebra striping (even:bg-gray-50), sticky headers (bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider), clear border-b.
component_instructions.forms: Labels must be bold and above inputs. Inputs must have clear borders (border-gray-300 focus:border-blue-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-800).
component_instructions.badges: Use semantic colors strictly for status (Operational, Pending, Critical). Rounded-full or rounded-md, text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5.
component_instructions.tabs: Underline style or simple segmented controls. No floating bubbles.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially gray secondary text, meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='report-problem-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure .js/.jsx. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Do not invent new colors. Stick strictly to the defined utilitarian palette.
Avoid any 'glow' or 'neon' effects. Delete any default box-shadows that look like glowing rings.
Tables are the heart of this app. Make them readable, compact, and scannable.
The troubleshooting chat UI should look like a standard enterprise chat (e.g., MS Teams or Slack), NOT a glowing AI orb.
Ensure the layout has a left Sidebar and a top header. The sidebar holds main navigation, header holds user profile and breadcrumbs.
For the login page, use a simple centered card layout on a gray background. No huge illustrations.
universal_guidelines: Do not apply global transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Apply transitions explicitly to colors/opacity.
Never center-align whole pages. Left-align content for natural reading flow.
Add data-testid to every clickable item, form input, and key data point.
Install lucide-react if not present, but it usually is.
No empty states with giant illustrations. Use simple text 'No records found.' and a plain icon.
